title: P1.36-B shabu from Laos shipment seized at Manila Port

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities intercepted a cargo from Laos carrying P1.36-billion worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) at the Manila International Container Port on Wednesday, Nov. 4. According to the Bureau of Customs (BOC), the 200-kilogram illegal substance was stored inside a 40-foot container. About 50 boxes were discovered, each containing four packs of alleged shabu. The operation stemmed from an intelligence report provided by the Vietnam Anti-Narcotics Police Department to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA).
